# phyto

> A free, open source presentation tool for worship gatherings at home. Prepare songs with chords and multiple languages, scripture from any YouVersion Bible, and media, group them into gatherings, present them live, and let everyone follow on their phones.

## Pages

- [Create](/): Build and manage sets of songs, scripture, and media. Group them into gatherings for live presentation.
- [About](/about): What phyto is and how it works.
- [Updates](/updates): Release history and updates.
- [Feedback](/feedback): Submit feedback, report bugs, or request features.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How user data is collected, stored, and used.
- [Terms of Use](/terms): Terms and conditions for using phyto.

## Optional

- [phyto on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/phyto.live): Follow for updates and community content.
- [Donate](/donate): Donate to support ongoing development.
